seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION6 with touching neighbours [hazard,wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x2, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.
